critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1276-1280 — Cohort create wraps _seed_default_assignments_for_cohort in try/except and only logs a warning on failure. Since the endpoint returns 200 regardless, a partial-failure could leave a cohort with 0 assignments; subsequent GET /api/cohorts/{id}/assignments will auto-heal (line 2140 re-seeds if none), so this is defensive-in-depth. Fine.

server.py:2140 — Auto-seed on GET is instructor-only (elif role in super_admin,instructor). If a student is the very first to hit /assignments on a cohort with no seeded assignments, they'd get an empty [] instead of the 4 defaults. Very unlikely edge case (creating cohort auto-seeds already), but consider allowing enrolled student GET to also auto-seed for absolute safety.

server.py:2154 — create_custom_assignment does NOT allow submission_type='' (generic homework); only the 4 named types are accepted. This is intentional per review-request but note it differs from Material.submission_type which allows empty=generic.

server.py:2244 — resolve_assignment_submit_link accepts optional cohort_id query param but doesn't actually use it. If a stable Thinkific link points to an assignment_id that has been moved between cohorts (unlikely), the resolver still returns the assignment's stored cohort_id. Fine, but consider removing the unused param to avoid confusion.

server.py:2260 migrate_to_assignments — Existing homework materials are matched by material_type='homework' with $or migrated_to_assignment not exist/False. Second run's stats show submissions_linked=0 because materials with migrated=True are excluded from the loop. Verified idempotent. Good.

server.py:2313 milestones.sort() — Sort key is (week_number, 1 if is_final_capstone else 0). Correct — this puts capstones AFTER regular milestones of the same week (e.g., week 14 regular before week 14 capstone). Kawasaki auto-seed already replaces the last milestone with capstone via _build_default_milestones so at seed time there's only ONE week-14 entry (the capstone). If migration adds another week-14 milestone from a pre-existing HW material, both would coexist which is likely intentional.

AssignmentsTab.js:317-333 — When editing, submission_type is not shown (correct — per spec 'submission_type NOT editable' preserves file format). However for existing business_questionnaire assignments, the questionnaire builder is still rendered separately for editing. Nice UX.

AssignmentsTab.js:57 — window.confirm() is a native browser dialog blocking the JS thread. Playwright cannot interact with it via UI; need page.evaluate('window.confirm = () => true') or page.on('dialog'). Consider migrating to a shadcn AlertDialog for consistency + testability. Not blocking.

AssignmentsTab.js:50-55 — copyStableLink builds link using window.location.origin. Correct for Thinkific embedding but if the app is proxied through Thinkific with a different host, students clicking the link would go to Thinkific-side origin. If that's the intended flow, fine; otherwise consider using REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL-derived origin for consistency. Not urgent.

CohortDetail.js:44 uses local state 'showCohortSettings' but I did not verify the closing/onOpenChange path fully. Playwright verified opening + save + toast, so the dialog integration works end-to-end.
